title: Keep a non-conflicting own change to a task the complete import holds owed to the next export
outcome: Keep a non-conflicting own change to a task the complete import holds owed to the next export
acceptance: After a complete (rebuild) import holds another host's edit of a task that carries a note this host has not published yet, and the hold later resolves through an incremental import with no new local event on that task, the next export publishes the note. A CLI behaviour test proves it.
